bullets.title: Rodtang vs. Superlek
bullets.note: Billed as “the biggest Thai boxing fight of all time,” this short fight showcases many weapons of Muay Thai, including the sharpest: elbows. The art of eight limbs is the fullest of full-contact, especially with MMA gloves. I think the outcome was a robbery, but there’s no denying the action.

bullets.title: Mark Zuckerberg: First Interview in the Metaverse
bullets.note: on [_The Lex Fridman Podcast_](https://lexfridman.com/podcast/). Even if you only watch the first five minutes, this is well worth the time. These next-gen, photo-realistic avatars and their motion tracking are truly jaw-dropping. The tech, and lag, are improving in leaps and bounds, and the future is going to get very weird very quickly.

bullets.title: The Five Minute Journal
bullets.note: ([Intelligent Change](https://www.intelligentchange.com/products/the-five-minute-journal), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Intelligent-Change-Mindfulness-Reflection-Affirmations/dp/0991846206/?th=1)). I use two types of journaling and alternate between them: [Morning Pages](https://tim.blog/2015/01/15/morning-pages/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) and The Five Minute Journal. The former I use primarily for getting unstuck or problem-solving (what should I do?); the latter I use for prioritizing and gratitude (how should I focus and execute?). The only thing I dislike about The Five Minute Journal? Their lack of hyphenation.
